I’m in: I commit to 18 tons when the stock is 100 and 2 tons when it is 20, provided all five explicitly accept the full rule before choosing. John’s $14,000 monthly average makes this more attractive than 10 each, although it depends on everyone keeping the agreement.

If an unexpected stock level arises because someone deviates, we should agree on revised whole-ton allocations before fishing, keeping at least 5 tons in the lake. We shouldn’t apply the 18-ton limit blindly or retaliate by overfishing.

Luke, does your commitment extend to the 2-ton limit at a stock of 20? Then Emma can confirm hers.
